chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Al-Husayn ibn Malik, who said:

I wrote to him: A man died and made everything of his during his lifetime, to be for you, and there was no child for him. Then a child was born (after his death) and his wealth had reached three thousand Dirham, and I had sent to you a thousand Dirhams. May I be sacrificed for you, So if you could let me know your view with regards to it, so that I can act upon it. So he wrote: 'I leave it for them'.
ai.seo_question: What happens to an estate if a child is born after the father's death when the will designated everything to someone else?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the Shia juristic principle that a child born after the testator's death is considered an heir and takes precedence over a specific bequest (*wasiyya*) to a non-heir, provided the estate exceeds the one-third limit for bequests. The Imam’s directive to 'release it to them' underscores the priority of *nasab* (lineage) in inheritance distribution, ensuring the posthumous child secures their obligatory share before the beneficiary claims the remainder.

en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Al Husayn, from Maalik who said,

‘I wrote to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man died and made everything of his during his lifetime, to be for you<sup>asws</sup>, and there was no child for him. Then a child was born (after his death) and his wealth had reached three thousand Dirham, and I had sent to you a thousand Dirhams. May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>, So if you<sup>asws</sup> could let me know your<sup>asws</sup> view with regards to it, so that I can act upon it’. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> leave it for them’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from al-Husayn ibn Malik who has narrated the following: “

I once wrote to him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘A man has died who in his lifetime had made everything that he had for you and he did not have any children, thereafter a child was born to him and his assets are three thousand dirham. He has sent to you one thousand dirham. I like to know your decision in the matter so I can follow.’ He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, wrote the answer that said, ‘I leave it for them.’”
